description:
Save the caller's draft; always succeeds even when the head has moved.

The first save records `base_revision`, the revision the editor saw, as the draft's base;
the item must exist at that revision. Later saves keep the draft's base unless
`base_revision` equals the current head, which is the explicit rebase.

base_revision.description: Revision the editor saw; equal to the current head to rebase after resolving a conflict.

body.description: Drafted Markdown body. At most 8388608 bytes in UTF-8: a character takes one to four.

item_id.description: Stable application item identity; paths remain the portable OKF identity.

workspace_id.description: Workspace whose permissions and storage scope apply.

title: SaveDraftRequest
